sloka: लोकानां स्वस्ति चैव स्यात्कृते कर्मणि च त्वया ।एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं लवणस्य दुरात्मनः ।। ७.६७.२४ ॥
transliteration: lokānāṁ svasti caiva syātkṛte karmaṇi ca tvayā ।etatte sarvamākhyātaṁ lavaṇasya durātmanaḥ ।। 7.67.24 ॥

translations.english: The welfare of the worlds will be achieved by this deed done by you, and all this about the wicked Lavana has been told to you.
